*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent} html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#000;color:#f8f4ff;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;overflow:hidden} button{font:inherit} #app{width:min(100vw,430px);height:100dvh;margin:auto;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% -8%,#54224f 0,#17101e 30%,#050509 78%)} .screen{position:absolute;inset:0;padding:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) 15px max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));display:none;overflow:auto} .screen.on{display:block;animation:fade .18s ease} @keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}} .logo{text-align:center;margin-top:10vh}.logoIcon{font-size:65px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #ff3158)} h1{font-size:43px;line-height:.88;letter-spacing:-3px;margin:7px 0;font-weight:1000;text-shadow:0 4px #000} h1 span{color:#ff3158}h2{font-size:25px;margin:5px 0 14px}.muted{color:#aaa4b7} .btn{width:100%;display:block;padding:14px;margin:6px 0;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #40374b;background:linear-gradient(#26202f,#111018);color:#fff;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 7px 18px #0009} .primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff3158,#7c2cff)!important;border-color:#ff6681!important} .btn:active{transform:scale(.985)}.btn:disabled{opacity:.4} .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-bottom:11px}.pill{background:#15131eea;border:1px solid #40374b;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:850} .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px}.card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#211a2c,#0d0c13);border:1px solid #443a50;border-radius:17px;padding:8px;text-align:center}.card.sel{border:2px solid #ff3158;box-shadow:0 0 18px #ff315833} .avatar{height:93px;border-radius:12px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#42264a,#111018);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:54px}.name{font-weight:950;margin-top:6px}.ability{font-size:10.5px;color:#c9c0d1;min-height:27px;margin-top:2px} .banner{padding:11px;border:1px solid #382f42;background:#111019dd;border-radius:14px;font-size:12px;color:#c8c0d1;margin:10px 0} .board{height:292px;border-radius:22px;border:1px solid #55445e;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 22%,#6d245d 0,transparent 23%),radial-gradient(circle at 20% 75%,#252056 0,transparent 30%),linear-gradient(145deg,#1b1628,#06060a)} .board:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:12px;border:2px dashed #743a50;border-radius:20px;transform:rotate(-2deg);opacity:.8} .node{position:absolute;width:31px;height:31px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:2;font-size:11px;font-weight:950;background:#151522;border:2px solid #767080;box-shadow:0 3px 7px #0009}.star{color:#ffd34d;border-color:#ffd34d;background:#39270b}.trap{color:#ff3158;border-color:#ff3158;background:#3d0e1a}.shop{color:#5ce39b;border-color:#5ce39b;background:#0d3223} .token{position:absolute;width:42px;height:42px;z-index:5;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:27px;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 5px #000);transition:left .34s ease,top .34s ease} .panel{background:#111019e8;border:1px solid #362f40;border-radius:15px;padding:11px;margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;min-height:47px} .twocol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.scoreRow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin-top:9px}.playerRow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #2e2936;background:#0e0d14cc;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px}.playerRow.me{border-color:#ff3158}.playerRow b{font-size:13px}.mini{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#21162c,#0b0a10);border:1px solid #443650;border-radius:20px;padding:16px;text-align:center}.bigscore{font-size:45px;font-weight:1000}.target{display:block;width:145px;height:145px;border-radius:50%;margin:15px auto;background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff 0 8%,#ff3158 9% 22%,#15111d 23% 40%,#9b5cff 41% 58%,#07060a 59%);border:5px solid #3a2945;box-shadow:0 0 25px #9b5cff44}.target:active{transform:scale(.94)} .shopGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.itemCard{padding:12px;border-radius:15px;border:1px solid #393344;background:#12101a;text-align:center}.itemCard strong{display:block;margin:4px}.itemCard small{color:#aaa4b7}.toast{position:absolute;z-index:30;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:23px;padding:12px;border-radius:14px;background:#0d0b13f7;border:1px solid #5b485f;text-align:center;transform:translateY(150%);transition:.2s;font-size:13px}.toast.show{transform:none}
